purpose: Bounded platform/development comparison; not confirmation, not trained controller benefit, not full-layer versus two-layer causality
target_rule: One all-one LoRA30-update reference per task, same root and stop examples; median stop CE at updates20/25/30. No policy-dependent target; no retuning if short or failed.
rule: Same shared information/interface: lower each layer base index by1 if cached potential>.10; otherwise raise by1 if current-target gap>.50 and prior-decision improvement<.02. In each layer correct at most2 experts with old-current top8 usage fraction>.02, ranked descending with lowest-index ties, to base-minus-one alphabet level. Base0 has no corrections.
strong_static_reference: Not calibrated in this short comparison; static050 is an a priori diagnostic candidate. Formal strong-static development selection remains unexecuted.
generation_score: All128 isolated NI eval examples per task; greedy<=32 tokens; normalized EM/tokenF1 against all original outputs. Record triangular loss and score matrices at every task completion.
general_evaluation: Before the history and at each candidate endpoint only, same always-enabled deployment adapters. Fixed unscored source/text-isolated612-example candidate target: four per each of57 MMLU subjects,128 PIQA validation,128 BoolQ validation,128 BBH logical-deduction-five-objects. Length<=512 and source/text exclusions predeclared; audit must pass. Single option-letter likelihood, no CoT; subset engineering readout, not full benchmark or TRACE reproduction. No metrics enter observations/reward/selection.
selection: None: execute fixed ordered menu, retain all endpoints/failures, no post-hoc expansion or learned winner search.
cost: Actual prefix executed once and restored for each candidate; report actual versus complete path separately. General initial evaluation reused once. All copies, scoring/generation, monitor, training/replay, control and wall time counted.
